content_sections.body: zero, one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten. Count objects with a number before the noun: one pen, two books.
content_sections.title: Count 0–10

content_sections.body:
Kim: How old are you?
Sam: I am ten. How old are you?
Kim: I am nine.
content_sections.title: Ask about age

exercises.prompt: Count and write the number word.
Use fictional characters aged six and ten. Ask and answer about each character's age.
exercises.rubric: Uses How old are you?; Answers with I am plus the correct number.; Says both assigned number words accurately.

objectives: Understand and use the numbers zero through ten.
Ask and answer How old are you? with a small fictional age for controlled practice.

constraints: Generate the sequence yourself; use no external recording.
listening.goal: Practise the listening target for this lesson.
listening.instruction: Say five numbers from zero to ten in a mixed order, pausing between them. Ask the learner to type the sequence, then show the answer and repeat once.

constraints: If audio is unavailable, state NOT_ASSESSED and offer articulatory guidance only.
Do not judge pronunciation from text.
pronunciation.goal: Practise the pronunciation target for this lesson.
pronunciation.instruction: Model three, six, seven, and ten. Ask for repetition, with special attention to the first sound in three and both syllables in seven.

constraints: Make clear that a fictional practice age is acceptable.
Use no more than four short turns.
speaking.goal: Practise the speaking target for this lesson.
speaking.instruction: Play a fictional classmate. Ask How old are you? Invite the learner to choose a practice age from six to ten, then switch roles.

constraints: Do not introduce numbers above ten.
Do not rewrite all three phrases.
writing.goal: Practise the writing target for this lesson.
writing.instruction: Ask the learner to write three short count phrases such as two pens, using different numbers from one to ten. Give bounded feedback, then request one revision.

title: Numbers from Zero to Ten
